items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Raymond played that all the time. And I liked it too. Because Raymond heard it too when Rene played it.

ctx.x: Down under beneath of Hawaii and Scotland.

It goes da da da da da da da da da da da da da. Raymond played that all the time. And I liked it too. Because Raymond heard it too when Rene played it. Now that's tunes that I played. And I always liked to play singing the blues. That was something pretty. I always played that. I never heard many bands play it. But I always featured a tune like that. Because it had beautiful harmony in it. And of course I couldn't have played it the way Biggs made it though. But I mean it was always a standard tune. And some of…
